name: imc_prosperity
description: IMC Prosperity 4 — 5 rounds of algorithmic + manual trading. Currency: XIRECs. Products introduced each round with independent position limits.

EMERALDS.notes: Precious gemstones with stable value. Tutorial product. Classic market-making target: quote tight around fair value, skew by inventory.

TOMATOES.notes: Tutorial product. Value fluctuates over time — use rolling mid or EMA as fair-value estimator.

INTARIAN_PEPPER_ROOT.notes: Hardy, slow-growing root with steady value. Treat like AMETHYSTS from prior years — hard-coded fair value MM with inventory skew. Position limit 80.

ASH_COATED_OSMIUM.notes: Appears unpredictable but 'may follow a hidden pattern'. Investigate: mean-reversion, regime detection, Bollinger-style entries. Do NOT pure MM in large moves. Position limit 80.

HYDROGEL_PACK.notes: Stable product ~10000 XIRECs. Pure inventory-skewed MM with spread 2-4 ticks. Treat like INTARIAN_PEPPER_ROOT at higher limit.

VELVETFRUIT_EXTRACT.notes: Underlying for all VEV options. Use its mid as S in Black-Scholes. Market-make independently AND use for delta hedging options book.

round_3_mechanics.tte: TTE = 5 trading days at round start. Decrements by 1 each IMC day (10000 ticks). Use (5 - day) / 252 years.
round_3_mechanics.options_style: European calls on VELVETFRUIT_EXTRACT. Cash-settled at round end. No early exercise.
round_3_mechanics.iv_calibrated: IV ≈ 0.23 (23% annualized). Consistent across VEV_5000–VEV_5500 at S=5250.
round_3_mechanics.strategy: IV smile arbitrage per Rook-E1: map IV vs moneyness, buy underpriced vol (IV below smile baseline), sell overpriced. Size proportional to deviation.
round_3_mechanics.biopod_rationale: Joint two-bid optimization: bid1=753 catches 17 counterparty tiers at 167 profit each; bid2=840 catches 17 more tiers at 80 profit each. Total E=4165 vs 3845 for naive bid1=795. bid2=840 is one step above Nash eq ~837 for penalty safety.

simulation_specs.notes: AWS Lambda — class-level variables do NOT persist between ticks. Only traderData string persists. Use jsonpickle to serialize state.

market_access_fee.description: bid() method returns an integer bid. Top 50% of bids across all teams get 25% extra order book volume. Fee is deducted from Round 2 PnL.
market_access_fee.formula: PnL = round2_profit - bid (if accepted) | PnL = round2_profit (if rejected)
market_access_fee.extra_volume: 25% more quotes inserted naturally into distribution
market_access_fee.strategy: Bid slightly above expected median. Extremely high bid guarantees access but sacrifices PnL. Negative bids treated as 0.
market_access_fee.testing_note: During testing, you see 80% of quotes (slightly randomized). bid() is ignored during testing.

manual_invest_expand.description: Allocate 50,000 XIRECs budget across Research, Scale, Speed (0-100% each, total <=100%).
manual_invest_expand.research: research(x) = 200000 * ln(1+x) / ln(101). Logarithmic. Max 200000 at x=100.
manual_invest_expand.speed: Rank-based across all players. Highest=0.9, Lowest=0.1, linear between ranks. Equal investments share same rank.
manual_invest_expand.strategy: Research is logarithmic so invest heavily early. Speed is competitive — must estimate median opponent speed spend.

manual_round_1.rules: Submit single limit order (price, qty). Exchange picks clearing price maximizing volume (tie: higher price). You are LAST to submit.
manual_round_1.strategy: Bid at or below buyback price. For DRYLAND_FLAX bid 30 (max profit, no fee). For EMBER_MUSHROOM bid at 20-fee=19.90 effective. Optimize clearing price vs quantity trade-off.

anti_patterns: Using old product names (AMETHYSTS, STARFRUIT, KELP) — Prosperity 4 has entirely new products.
Assuming position limit is 20 or 50 — all Round 1/2 products have limit 80.
Not implementing bid() for Round 2 — zero bid means no extra market access, but at least you won't pay a fee.
Bidding the maximum for market access without estimating cost vs. extra volume value.
Class-level mutable state — AWS Lambda re-creates the Trader instance each tick. Use traderData JSON.
Exceeding 50,000 chars in traderData — it will be silently truncated.
Symmetric MM on ASH_COATED_OSMIUM without regime detection — the 'hidden pattern' implies regime-aware entries.
Forgetting sell_orders quantities are NEGATIVE in OrderDepth.
Sending aggregated buy qty that would exceed limit-pos — exchange rejects ALL orders for that product.
Using external libraries — only stdlib + pandas, numpy, statistics, math, typing, jsonpickle are allowed.
submission_requirements: Single Trader class with run(state: TradingState) -> (orders_by_product, conversions, traderData).
Optional bid() -> int method for Round 2 market access fee (ignored other rounds).
Import only from datamodel and allowed stdlib/libraries.
No network I/O, no disk I/O, no subprocess.
traderData must be a string <= 50,000 characters.
past_round_notes: INTARIAN_PEPPER_ROOT behaves like AMETHYSTS (prior years) — stable fair value, pure inventory-skewed MM.
ASH_COATED_OSMIUM has a 'hidden pattern' hinted by IMC — investigate autocorrelation, regime breaks, Bollinger z-score.
Round 2 MAF: optimal bid is slightly above the median expected competitor bid. Modelling competitor behavior game-theoretically is key.
Round 2 manual: Research is most capital-efficient early (log curve). Speed is purely competitive — estimate median.
Round 1 manual auction: you submit last, so bid the buyback price or just below to maximize fill at max buyback profit.
prompt_addendum: Context: IMC Prosperity 4. Round 1/2 products: INTARIAN_PEPPER_ROOT (stable, limit 80), ASH_COATED_OSMIUM (volatile/patterned, limit 80). Tutorial: EMERALDS, TOMATOES (limit 80). Round 3+ products: HYDROGEL_PACK (stable ~10000, limit 200), VELVETFRUIT_EXTRACT (underlying ~5250, limit 200), VEV_4000/4500/5000/5100/5200/5300/5400/5500/6000/6500 (European call options, limit 300 each, TTE=5 days at round start, IV~0.23). Trader MUST implement run(state: TradingState) -> (orders, conversions, traderData). AWS Lambda — use traderData JSON (max 50k chars). DO NOT use old product names. For options: use Black-Scholes with r=0, extract IV per strike, fit IV smile, buy underpriced vol (IV below baseline), sell overpriced vol (IV above baseline), size proportional to deviation. Delta-hedge with VELVETFRUIT_EXTRACT. Bio-Pod manual: Bid1=795, Bid2=800.
